description: This file contains a static class 'Converter' that provides methods to convert charting objects (Font, LineFormat, FillFormat) into PdfSharp.Drawing objects (XFont, XPen, XBrush) for rendering purposes.

classes.name: Converter
classes.description: Provides static methods to convert charting DOM objects into PdfSharp.Drawing objects.

methods.name: ToXFont
methods.description: Converts a Font object into an XFont, using defaultFont attributes for missing properties.

methods.name: ToXPen
methods.description: Creates an XPen based on a LineFormat object, with fallback to default pen properties.

methods.name: ToXBrush (FillFormat)
methods.description: Creates an XBrush based on a FillFormat object, defaulting to a specified color.

methods.name: ToXBrush (Font)
methods.description: Creates an XBrush based on a Font object, defaulting to a specified color.
